name: SharePoint Beta
description: SharePoint connector with .docx support for content read/write and comment management via Microsoft Graph.

config_variables.name: SHP_ID_APP
config_variables.label: App Client ID
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client ID

config_variables.name: SHP_ID_APP_SECRET
config_variables.label: App Client Secret
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client secret

tools.name: list_documents
tools.documentation: List documents in the configured SharePoint library scope.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.documentation: Get document content. .md returns plain text, .docx returns extracted plain text, others return Base64.

tools.name: create_document
tools.documentation: Create a new document in SharePoint. Supports .md and .docx. For .docx, content is markdown rendered into a formatted Word document (headings, bold/italic, lists, tables, code, blockquotes).

tools.name: update_document
tools.documentation: Update an existing document in SharePoint. Supports .md and .docx. For .docx, content is markdown rendered into a formatted Word document while preserving existing comments.

tools.name: get_document_comments
tools.documentation: Get all comments embedded in a .docx document, including ID, author, date, and text.

tools.name: update_document_comment
tools.documentation: Update the text of a specific comment in a .docx document by its comment ID.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.documentation: Add a threaded reply to an existing comment in a .docx document by its comment ID.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.documentation: Add a new comment anchored to a specific line of text in a .docx document.
